journeys.introduction: One journey: an owner creates a link and later checks on it.

journey.name: Create and monitor a link
journey.argument: An owner needs to go from a target URL to a shareable short code, and back to its click count later.

state.carries: The target URL the owner is creating a link for.
state.creates: A new link row and its minted short code.
state.completes: The owner has a shareable short code.
state.abandonment: Closing the form before submitting mints nothing.
